latest_rss.title: 助手長子或作代理人 湯家驊：可聘律師抗辯

latest_rss.title: 年底屆限期 15體育總會管治未達標 羅淑佩：不「一刀切」扣撥款

latest_rss.title: 綠運規管草案末季推 採港鐵票價調整機制
latest_rss.summary: 【明報專訊】政府持續發展新型集體運輸系統，運輸及物流局昨向立法會提交文件，公布智慧綠色運輸系統的擬議規管框架，目標今年第四季提交主體法例草案。新框架規定，首段專營權一般將不多於50年，每次續期不超過5年。啟德、東九龍及洪水橋／厦村3個現行項目，將採用與港鐵相似票價方程式，容許自動調整而毋須逐次審批（見另稿）。有業界預料該等項目專營權年期應為約20年，關注若營運期限屆滿後資產移交能否靠續期解決，或仍需重新招標。

latest_rss.title: 方程式仿港鐵 票價掛鈎通脹工資

latest_rss.title: 屯門焚化爐造價292億 較原估算降兩成

latest_rss.title: What the War Against Iran Means for the U.S.-South Korean Alliance
latest_rss.summary:
South Korea’s security is no longer confined to the peninsula. That is the real lesson from the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz. And if decision-makers in Seoul didn’t understand this before, they surely understand this now.The U.S.-South Korean alliance was built to deter North Korea, defend South Korea, and stabilize Northeast Asia. That mission remains indispensable, but a serious disruption in the Strait of Hormuz now hits South Korea directly through energy imports, shipping, industrial production, and economic confidence. For Seoul, this is not someone else’s regional crisis — it is a direct test of South Korean national resilience.
